products.name: Elektra Series 3/3
tabs: Elektra Series 3/3 is an IT-grade high-frequency online double-conversion UPS engineered for mission-critical three-phase power protection across data centers, medical labs, and enterprise IT infrastructure.

Built with a compact footprint and full DSP digital control, the system delivers zero transfer time (0ms), an active input power factor above 0.99, and up to 94% operational efficiency (exceeding 98% in ECO mode) to significantly lower total operating costs.

Its robust topology guarantees stable, surge-free power even under heavy electrical disturbances, supporting 100% unbalanced load capacity and broad generator synchronization across fluctuating utility grids.
Capacity Range: 08 kVA to 200 kVA (scalable up to 500 kVA 3-phase in / 3-phase out).
True Online Double-Conversion Topology with 0ms transfer time for uninterrupted continuity.
High Output Power Factor: 0.9 standard (unity PF 1.0 available on request).
Active Power Factor Correction (PFC): Input PF > 0.99 with low harmonic distortion (THDi ≤ 3%).
Ultra-Wide Input Range: 208–478 VAC voltage and 40–70 Hz frequency for seamless generator compatibility.
Dual LCD & LED Display: Real-time telemetry monitoring for load status, voltage, frequency, and fault history.
Intelligent Battery Management: Cold DC start capability and flexible battery string configurations (16/18/20 or 32–40 blocks).
Emergency Power Off (EPO) and full support for unbalanced loads.
Target Applications: Hyperscale and enterprise data centers, telecom VoIP nodes, medical diagnostic labs, railway control systems, and automated industrial plants.
Standard Communication Ports: USB, RS232, RS485, Parallel redundancy bus, and programmable dry contacts.
Optional Network Interfaces: Intelligent smart slot for SNMP network cards, AS400 relay cards, and environmental monitoring probes.
Safety Standards: Fully compliant with IEC/EN 62040-1 and IEC/EN 60950-1.
EMC & Immunity Compliance: Certified to IEC/EN 62040-2, IEC 61000-4-2, IEC 61000-4-3, IEC 61000-4-4, IEC 61000-4-5, IEC 61000-4-6, and IEC 61000-4-8.
Environmental & Overload Resilience: High overload endurance with optional dust-proof filtration kits for harsh industrial conditions.
